messages:
Priya M: Morning all — quick async standup. What I did: finished the draft of the roadmap slice for prioritization (routes + latency targets), pushed spec to PR #812. Blockers: still waiting on infra numbers from Mateo for the batching perf; also need a decision on whether we keep 95th p99 latency target for small requests. Today: pair with Alex on rollout plan and tag owners for CRs.

Alex H: thanks — saw the PR, left a couple inline comments. quick note: if we keep the p99 target we'll need conservative batching config. I can prototype a conservative policy today.

Mateo R: infra numbers incoming — ran the microbench on dedicated pool last night, results look ok but need one more run with quantized model. ETA ~2h. Also observed occasional KV cache misses at scale.

Priya M: @Mateo R awesome — please drop the run results in the PR as a short table. If KV cache misses persist that's a blocker for our low-latency tier.

Casey L: Blocker for me: CR reviewers are overloaded. Left review on #812; can we schedule a 15m review sync so we don't stall the spec? I'm free 3:30pm PT.

Jordan C: I can make 3:30. Also have a follow-up question — are we comfortable with automatic fallback to the smaller model when capacity is low? This was flagged by support as a risky UX change.

Priya M: Jordan good point. Proposal: allow fallback but add explicit telemetry and a consent flag per customer. That way we can roll out gradually. Thoughts?

Alex H: I like consent flag idea. We should also add a short note in the spec about user-visible behaviour and the Console UI change required.

Samir: FYI deploy-bot reported a failed canary last night on dedicated-02, possibly unrelated but might affect capacity testing: "deploy-bot: canary healthcheck failed 2023-11-22T02:14Z (route prune)". Ops will investigate.

Priya M: thanks @Samir. @deploy-bot can you paste the failure logs or link the incident thread?

deploy-bot: https://infra.company.internal/incidents/2342 — logged the stack trace and node metrics.

Mateo R: saw the incident; I'll coordinate with eng-infra. For the quantized run: results posted to PR in ~90m.

Casey L: Scheduling: let's do the 15m review at 3:30 PT. I'll invite the small group: @Priya M, @Alex H, @Jordan C, @Mateo R. If anyone can't make, post a short comment and we'll record the meeting.

Priya M: sounds good. Action items: 1) Mateo — post quantized perf numbers; 2) Alex — prototype conservative batching policy; 3) Casey — run CR sync at 3:30 PT; 4) Jordan — draft fallback telemetry spec paragraph; 5) Samir/eng-infra — investigate canary logs. I'll merge the spec after we get perf + one review. :thumbsup: 

Alex H: noted. I'll try to get a prototype out before lunch.

Jordan C: drafting telemetry paragraph now, will push a small PR.

Casey L: invite sent (3:30 PT), calendar says 15m.

Priya M: thanks team. If anything blocks immediate progress, ping me here. Otherwise we'll reconvene after the sync. :rocket:
